```{r, include=FALSE}
# Clear active workspace memory at the start of interactive runs
rm(list = ls())

# Ensure renv loads from the project directory
if (requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Points to the main project folder containing .Rprofile / renv.lock
  renv::load(project = "..")
}

# Set global code chunk options for Quarto / R Markdown rendering
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,          # Show code chunks in final report
  warning = FALSE,      # Hide package execution warnings
  message = FALSE,      # Hide library load startup messages
  fig.width = 8,        # Standardize figure width
  fig.height = 5,       # Standardize figure height
  fig.align = "center"  # Center plot outputs
)
```

## Data Load-In (Nick)

```{r}
library(readr)
coffee_ratings <- read_csv("../data_info/coffee_ratings.csv")
head(coffee_ratings)
```

```{r}
str(coffee_ratings)
```

## Data Introduction and Exploration (Nick)

```{r}
summary(coffee_ratings$total_cup_points)
```

```{r}
# Histogram of Total Cup Points
hist(
  coffee_ratings$total_cup_points,
  col = "lightgray",
  main = "Histogram of Total Cup Points",
  xlab = "Total Cup Points"
)
```

```{r}
# Distribution of bean species
table(coffee_ratings$species)
```

```{r}
# Distribution of processing method
table(coffee_ratings$processing_method)
```
